description: Signed zero and infinite bases, infinite exponents, [16].
reference: torch.pow(a, b) in f64, rounded once to f32
notes: Expected NaN must be NaN (any NaN matches any NaN) and expected ±inf must be the same inf. The sign of a zero or infinite result follows the base for odd integer exponents. out is computed in f64 from the inputs and rounded once to the dtype under test, so the bytes don't depend on the CPU's vectorized kernels; torch in the dtype itself meets the tolerance (checked by the generator).
